shared.controller: same model/provenance rules/edits+focus envelope; G only has minimal one-note representation contract

budget_scope: Only State content chars are matched by this aggregate bound; title/needs/refs/raw sources/checkpoint and actual wire bytes are separately measured. No silent content or message truncation.
source_freeze: Published source/actual config/input identity bound by runner prepare; freeze all four full trajectories
scoring: Unchanged original strict P1 rubric; separately inspect retained/changed facts, actual recovery actions, G/L bytes/operations/limits/no-op and source activation. All errors stay in denominators.
causal_limits: One exposed repetition and online trajectories; not stable efficacy.
G requires a representation instruction and single-note schema; retained joint focus is generated but unused by both arms.

Whole-note rewrite and local edits may face different pressure under same 2048 output limit. If G truncates, report capacity-related incomparability for pure representation claims; do not tune mid-batch.
This is not LRU or sparse update candidate selection.
Conservative dependency deletion may remove all of G note; state granularity is itself part of the representation.
stop_rule: Complete four runs through semantic/capacity failures; stop only for infrastructure or deterministic execution-invalidity. No broad benchmark or parameter sweep based on a successful one-off case.
